decision: REJECT: no native JMdict gain, repeated regression evidence, duplicate structural hypothesis; no product PR or browser qualification
source: Per-observation totals and aggregate summaries printed in completed original workflow job logs; all252 logged observations are retained below. Detailed per-group bytes, digests, cold/module times and machine manifests remain in the seven linked original artifacts. No archive contents have been downloaded or invented.

methodology.arms: A/C identical baseline WASM, B candidate; baseline JavaScript for all
methodology.metric: Component only: native inflate/CRC plus parsing/content encoding/lookup preparation. parseThreadCpuMs excludes inflate/CRC. Does not include result copies/IPC/OPFS or browser whole-import latency.
methodology.ordering: All six ABC permutations twice; JMdict cohort2 reverses both block and within-block ordering.
methodology.bootstrap: Original driver seeded Random(20261128),10000 block bootstrap resamples; intervals are equal-work ratios, not median intervals.

qualifications: All real corpus observations completed full output byte oracle and zero fused fallbacks.

All three synthetic unique-key controls are inadmissible for target-path negative control because2banks×30000rows exceeded existing per-bank sizing and every repetition fell back. A corrected6banks×10000 design was prepared but not launched after candidate rejection and duplicate ownership discovery.
Local interrupted/slow observations are retained in the candidate lab local-attempts.json; this evidence does not replace or exclude them.
The original run completed all7 jobs successfully; workflow success is correctness/completion, not evidence of a speedup.
No broader browser study or new acquisition was triggered for this rejected candidate.
